records.header_literal: D) UKS v BSL (09.29 a.m., November 28th); KR 0912 (11/28); RICHI-272
records.readable_german: OKM. Auf Befehl der REICHSLEITG ist jeder Kampf zu vermeiden. Eingehen auf FRANZ Forderungen notwendig. Weitere Befehle folgen. OHLXAXX280GEH. OPJANG.
records.meaning: The message instructs OKM, on the order of the authority labeled REICHSLEITG, to avoid any fighting, says compliance with demands labeled FRANZ is necessary, and promises further orders. FRANZ is read as an abbreviation for French in this context; the source does not spell that word out. The message records an instruction, not proof that fighting stopped or that the demands were fulfilled.
notes: All 272 printed coordinates are present and legible, with no source erasures. The source photograph includes a complete group absent from the earlier OCR; restoring that visible group is a transcription correction, not an inserted historical coordinate.
The high-resolution source reads FFFVD, including the third F with its middle bar. It is not treated as an invented missing coordinate or a T-shaped source mask.
The wording proposals 1EDER to JEDER and ZT to ZU cost four observed-coordinate substitutions in total. REICHSLEITG and FRANZ remain abbreviated.
Y is the separator in this period key. The closing OHLXAXX280GEH and OPJANG are preserved literally; 280 is not turned into a calendar date or a reference number with an inferred format.
